title: CanIToolCall model family
description: fixtures/<slug>/family.json: metadata shared by every fixture of one tool-call format family.

markers.description: Format markers (special tokens and structural tags) that must never leak into parsed content, reasoning_content or arguments unless the expected result contains them verbatim.

reference_models.description: Models whose tokenizer/template adapters use for this family, keyed by variant label (e.g. "qwen3-hybrid", "qwen3-thinking-2507").

stop_tokens.description: Stop token strings from generation_config.json / the engine; the text in raw_output ends before these.

gated.description: true when the HF repo requires accepting a license; adapters must then use a documented mirror of the template/tokenizer.

format_notes.description: Repo-relative path of the human-readable format notes (docs/formats/<slug>.md).
